name: Lucana
description: Trusted fishing tackle brand for rods, reels, lures, lines, and accessories across freshwater and saltwater angling.
intro: Lucana is positioned as a reliable performance brand with tackle options for beginners, enthusiasts, and tournament anglers.
history: Lucana has grown through practical product innovation for local and regional fishing conditions, with a strong focus on durability and angler confidence.

name: Tackleman
description: Versatile fishing equipment range offering strong value and dependable performance across lure, reel, rod, and terminal setups.
intro: Tackleman delivers adaptable products for day-to-day angling needs across freshwater and coastal fishing styles.
history: Tackleman products are selected for consistent field performance and easy serviceability, making them ideal for both retail and wholesale demand.

name: Daiwa
description: Daiwa is one of the world's leading fishing tackle manufacturers, founded in Japan and known for premium innovation.
intro: Global innovation leader in high-performance fishing gear trusted by anglers worldwide.
history: Daiwa is one of the world's leading fishing tackle manufacturers, founded in Japan. The company is known for innovation, premium-quality rods, reels, lures, and advanced fishing technologies used by anglers worldwide.

name: Bravo
description: Quality-focused tackle lineup designed for durability, balanced action, and dependable angling results.
intro: Bravo provides practical tackle options suited for regular anglers and developing sport-fishing markets.
history: Bravo products are positioned as robust and user-friendly for anglers looking for reliable rods, lures, and accessories.

name: FireFox
description: Performance-oriented tackle brand focused on casting confidence, lure control, and consistent fishing output.
intro: FireFox combines modern tackle styling with practical utility for active freshwater and inshore anglers.
history: FireFox products are curated for anglers who prioritize responsive gear and value-driven performance in varied fishing conditions.

name: Pioneer
description: Pioneer offers fishing tackle, rods, reels, accessories, and angling equipment for versatile fishing techniques.
intro: Pioneer emphasizes broad tackle coverage with a practical mix of gear for recreational and serious anglers.
history: Pioneer is recognized for covering essential angling categories with dependable products tailored for multiple species and fishing styles.
